verified_facts_for_researcher.ecc_end_of_maintenance: SAP ERP 6.0 (Business Suite 7) mainstream maintenance ends 31 Dec 2027; optional extended maintenance until end of 2030 at +2% on standard fees. (support.sap.com maintenance strategy; Rimini Street; Natuvion). RE-CONFIRM via SAP official before publishing.
verified_facts_for_researcher.ecc_2031_2033_option: Q1 2025 SAP announced 'SAP ERP, private edition, transition option' extending ECC support 2031-2033 for select large/complex customers who sign a RISE with SAP cloud subscription; requires moving to HANA DB by end of 2030 and dropping unsupported third-party tooling (e.g., Java). (Forrester 2025; 2-data; TJC Group). RE-CONFIRM scope/conditions via SAP official.
verified_facts_for_researcher.rise_vs_grow: RISE with SAP = for existing/complex SAP customers modernizing their landscape; core = SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition; offers BOTH public and private deployment paths; bundles platform services, Business Process Intelligence (Signavio), SAP Business Network, BTP credits. GROW with SAP = for NET-NEW SAP customers adopting cloud ERP from scratch; SAP S/4HANA Cloud PUBLIC Edition only; standardized best-practice processes, fast onboarding (go-live as fast as ~4 weeks). (SAP Learning; Crowe Indonesia; Arvato). RE-CONFIRM current bundle inclusions via SAP official.
verified_facts_for_researcher.deployment_models: S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition (multi-tenant, standardized, fit-to-standard) vs Private Edition (single-tenant, more customization/control). GROW=public only; RISE=public or private.
verified_facts_for_researcher.phased_vs_big_bang: Big bang = whole org cuts over at once (faster, potentially cheaper, higher risk, needs full validation). Phased = by location/function/BU with parallel run (lower risk, better adoption/training cadence, longer, higher running cost). Phased recommended for most mid-market/complex enterprises; big bang only when processes standardized + leadership commitment high + data fully validated. (Panorama; Captivea; Arion ERP).
verified_facts_for_researcher.partner_selection_criteria: Partner tier/certification (SAP Platinum highest), industry vertical experience, certified consultant bench depth, customization+local integration (e-Faktur/PPN/PPh for Indonesia), post-go-live support/SLA/escalation, data migration + integration capability, structured global methodology (e.g., SAP Activate). Generic claim 'success ~80% depends on partner quality' appears in ID SAP-partner content - frame as widely-cited industry view, not a hard SAP stat. (8thinktank; sapbusinessone.id; ImpactFirst).
verified_facts_for_researcher.readiness_dimensions: ERP/cloud migration readiness assessment = structured PRE-project evaluation across: business/strategy alignment & objectives; current system & landscape inventory (sizing, architecture, custom code); data quality & mapping by department; security & compliance posture; people/skills readiness & change capacity; cost/TCO baseline; integration/system compatibility. SAP-specific tools to mention: SAP Readiness Check, SAP Signavio Process Insights, SAP Transformation Navigator. (SAP ERP migration checklist; ERP Software Blog; TierPoint). RE-CONFIRM SAP Readiness Check scope via SAP official.
